config.label: Password for the configured profile; a per-profile SSH_MCP_<PROFILE>_PASSWORD takes precedence
config.description: Password for the configured profile; a per-profile SSH_MCP_<PROFILE>_PASSWORD takes precedence. Credentials are never accepted as CLI arguments.

config.label: Path to the private key file to authenticate with — the path, not the key material
config.description: Path to the private key file to authenticate with — the path, not the key material. A per-profile SSH_MCP_<PROFILE>_KEY takes precedence.

config.label: Passphrase for an encrypted private key
config.description: Passphrase for an encrypted private key.

config.label: Password the sudo tool escalates with, when the policy in force allows the privileged class
config.description: Password the sudo tool escalates with, when the policy in force allows the privileged class.
